title: Easier to use with a keyboard or screen reader
summary: Demo videos on the website now have a visible pause and play control, and pausing the feature rotation also pauses the clip. The overview cards have a clearer focus order with one breakdown button per card, the mobile menu keeps keyboard focus inside it while open, and form fields have higher-contrast borders. The currency convert button in settings is visible again, and the German pages announce their language correctly to assistive technology.
